# AdaptiveThrottleManager

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.AdaptiveThrottleManager`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Dynamically adjusts the degree of parallelism (DOP) for bulk DML operations in response to Dataverse 429 (service protection limit) errors. Complementary to PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.AdaptiveBatchSizer which adjusts batch SIZE; this class adjusts thread COUNT.

#### .ctor

```text
public System.Void .ctor(System.Int32 maxDop, System.Int32 initialDop = 0, System.Int32 successThreshold = 5, System.Nullable`1<System.TimeSpan> cooldownPeriod = default, System.Func`1<System.DateTime> clock = default)
```

Initializes a new instance of the PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.AdaptiveThrottleManager class.

- Parameter `maxDop`: Maximum degree of parallelism (upper bound). Must be at least 1.
- Parameter `initialDop`: Initial active DOP. If zero or negative, defaults to maxDop. Clamped to [1, maxDop].
- Parameter `successThreshold`: Number of consecutive successes required before DOP can increase. Default: 5.
- Parameter `cooldownPeriod`: Minimum time after a throttle before DOP can increase. Default: 30 seconds. If null, uses F:PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.AdaptiveThrottleManager.DefaultCooldownPeriod.
- Parameter `clock`: Optional clock function for testability. Returns UTC now. If null, uses P:System.DateTime.UtcNow.

#### RecordSuccess

```text
public System.Void RecordSuccess()
```

Records a successful batch execution. After P:PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.AdaptiveThrottleManager.SuccessThreshold consecutive successes AND P:PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.AdaptiveThrottleManager.CooldownPeriod since the last throttle, increments the active DOP by one (up to P:PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.AdaptiveThrottleManager.MaxDop).


#### RecordThrottle

```text
public System.Void RecordThrottle()
```

Records a throttle (429) event. Halves the active DOP (minimum 1), resets the consecutive success counter, and records the throttle timestamp.
